fields.statement: Verifier at 6a2f4a2a ran go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestCIStability|TestShipCheckStabilityRecord' -count=1 -v: PASS. TestCIStability covers an empty record (stable), a flake inside the 20-run window (unstable) and the same flake pushed out by 20 later clean runs (stable), window 5 shrinking and still holding, a red main result (unstable) cleared by a later green main record, a red main outliving the window, and a red PR head not counting as main. A ship check --main subtest takes a hand-written red main record to stable through a tree-equal merge. The green-dispatched-run path is covered by the pure verdict over a later green Main record together with TestShipCheckStabilityRecord/main_tree_differs, which records the dispatched run's green as a Main run. The ciWindow setting defaults to 20 and validates whole numbers of at least 1. A hand run of a scratch build in a hermetic repo: rhiza daemon set rhiza.ship.ciWindow 0 and abc each exit 2 with 'must be a whole number of at least 1', and 5 is accepted and listed as (git config, project). TestScripts/describe-golden passes, and go vet and gofmt are clean on internal/api. Reading the diff: ciVerdict checks the last window runs for flakes and main's latest run for red. ciStabilityVerdict, which reads the setting, has no test and no caller yet. TestScripts/daemon-settings fails here with 'a Rhiza repository already exists in /home/rhiza/code/rhiza', and it fails the same way at the parent commit, so the cause is the environment, not this leaf.
